queries:
To determine if you can get a Certificate of Eligibility (COE) for a VA-backed mortgage loan as a surviving spouse, you need to meet one of the following conditions regarding the Veteran's status and your own eligibility:

- The Veteran is missing in action (MIA), or
- The Veteran is a prisoner of war (POW), or
- The Veteran died from a service-connected disability, or
- The Veteran died while on active duty, or
- The Veteran died from a non-service-connected disability but was receiving VA compensation for a service-connected disability at the time of death, or
- You are receiving Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) from the VA.

Since you confirmed the Veteran was a prisoner of war, you may qualify for a COE under the POW provision. To proceed, you will need to submit an application (VA Form 26-1880) along with proof of the Veteran's POW status and your marriage certificate. The VA will review your application to confirm eligibility.
